messages:
ana (AE): Heads-up — MerchantCorp needs final sign-off on KMS/HSM requirements before we push the PO. They want BYOK with HSM attestation, customer rotation windows, and a clear latency SLA (they quoted p95 <= 25ms for keywrap). Can SE + SRE confirm technical feasibility and cost delta?

devon (SE): Short answer: doable, but specifics matter. Options: 1) Hosted + external BYOK (proxy to customer HSM) => extra network hop (~30-50ms typical), attestation still possible but depends on HSM vendor; 2) Dedicated with local key-proxy (our private edge) => ~8-15ms p95 for keywrap based on recent bench. Need to know whether they require HSM in their DC or cloud HSM (CloudHSM/Thales). :thinking_face:

erin (SRE): For numbers: our internal test (dedicated, 1x proxy, inter-node network) shows median 6ms, p95 12ms for AES-GCM keywrap. External HSM roundtrip (cross-AZ to vendor) adds 25-40ms variance. Also note: rotation playbook can be automated but full zero-downtime rotation requires prefix/KV caching TTLs adjusted. If they want strict <25ms p95 we should push Dedicated + co-located key-proxy.

matt (AE): Pricing impact: Dedicated + HSM proxy = reserved capacity fee + ops surcharge for KMS ops. Ballpark: +$12k/month committed, +$0.002 per KMS op beyond baseline. If they accept Hosted-with-proxy (no dedicated GPU commit) reduced infra commitment but higher per-op latency and variable egress costs. I can model both scenarios for the contract.

carmen (Security): Checklist clarifications from security questionnaire: we need to deliver HSM attestation report, key lifecycle diagram, KMS rotation frequency options, KMS access control (RBAC + audit logs), and a playbook for emergency key rollback. They also asked about split-key (M-of-N) support — we can integrate with their external KMS or provide manual ceremony docs.

ana (typo fix) OOPS ignore

ana? (not present) <-- ignore

jordan (CSM): MerchantCorp requested a 2-week POC window starting Mon 2026-06-01 for functional + perf validation. Action items: SE to provide test vectors and a lightweight harness so they can run latency/throughput tests; Security to provide sanitized attestation sample; SRE to reserve a Dedicated slot for the POC and confirm observability hooks.

devon (SE): I can push a test harness by EOD Thu. I'll include a small load script and example curl for keywrap ops: ```bash
# sample keywrap test
for i in {1..1000}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/kms/keywrap \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"key_id":"cust-kek-01","plaintext":"$(uuidgen)"}'
  done
```
I'll also include instructions to simulate rotation via the API.

deploy-bot: New artifact uploaded: /docs/hsm-attestation-sample-2026-05.pdf (permissions: sales, security).

matt (AE): SE/SRE, can you confirm whether the POC needs full HSM hardware (we can do simulator) or just KMS API surface? Customer's legal says "hardware attested HSM only" in an answer. If they insist on hardware attestation we need vendor paperwork and likely a 2-3 day scheduling window for key-ceremony support.

erin (SRE): If they require vendor-provided hardware in their DC: schedule impact of ~7-10 days (network, firewall rules, and attestation). If it's cloud HSM (their cloud account), we can usually onboard in 48-72 hours once IAM & peering are set. For the POC, recommend we offer a hybrid: simulate attestation for functional tests and schedule real attestation during the second week.

carmen (Security): Also note: rotation window policy — they asked for weekly rotations; our default recommended is 90 days for KEK, 30 days for ephemeral. Weekly KEK rotation is unusual and increases operational burden; need to confirm business justification.

ana again random typo ignore

ana is not in participants

jordan (CSM): I'll push back on weekly rotation and ask for use case. For the POC kickoff, requested deliverables: 1) test harness (SE) 2) sanitized attestation (Security) 3) reserved Dedicated slot + metrics dashboard (SRE) 4) pricing scenarios (AE). Can we agree to deliver those by Fri EOD so we can start Mon?

devon (SE): Agree. I'll upload harness + sample results to the POC workspace and post a quick runbook.

erin (SRE): I'll reserve a 2-node Dedicated slot for week 1 and enable token-level tracing for keywrap ops. Will confirm firewall ports (443, 853, tcp 15001 for proxy) and post a short network checklist.

matt (AE): I'll prepare two price options and a one-page addendum for the contract (attestation timeline + ops surcharge).

carmen (Security): I'll redact attestation sample and provide the rotation playbook. Also will ask legal to confirm whether split-key ceremony is contractually required.
